cases.name: Leisa Renae Martin
cases.about: Her Find-a-Grave said: "She lived in Sioux Falls and Fargo, North Dakota and moved to Bagley as a young child. She was baptized at the First Lutheran Church in Sioux Falls and Confirmed at Faith Lutheran Church in Bagley. She attended Bagley High School and was active in the Faith Lutheran Luther League, 4-H, and Danceline. She graduated in 1985. She attended North Dakota State University in Fargo, graduating in 1989 with a Bachelor of Arts degree in home economics and art. She moved to the Twin Cities in 1989 and worked at Carson Prairie Scott Department Store and at Contempo. She moved back to Bagley in 1993 and was employed at Herbergers Department Store in Bemidji. She also was employed at A plus Demonstrations where she would set up displays at different stores for clothing. She was a member of Faith Lutheran Church. She loved cats and her dog. She enjoyed the outdoors and loved working with fashion and clothes. She was a good listener to everyone and was very caring and supportive of friends and family and especially looked out for her two brothers."
cases.relationship: Brother / stepbrother / partner or sibling's brother / brother-in-law
cases.narrative: On 10/31/1998, a farmer found her body in a shallow grave along the Strawberry Mountain Trail, about 150 yards into Mahnomen County, MN, in the woods of the White Earth Indian Reservation. She had been strangled.
